authority.source: UrAi Generic World Library governed modular specification; generic exploration candidate

prompt: Original generic modular architecture-shell; one separable asset, not a whole environment. No real place/person, brands, logos, visible text, sci-fi, low-poly filler, floating parts or intersecting geometry. Physically plausible PBR, believable wear, correct UVs/normals; meter scale, +Y up, reusable grounded pivot. Single-height beds by default, 2 m central aisle and clear exterior door. Bunk variant requires safe non-climbing camera behavior and separately reviewed scale. Target bounding dimensions 10m wide x 3m high x 8m deep. Materials: paint-institutional-soft. Clear passage where applicable; no arms/hands, forced characters or inaccessible hazards. GLB with embedded PBR textures. Generic exploration candidate only; visual/rights review required.
